algorithm.antiwindup: Original coefficient advance uses the ceiling that generated the current request, before updating next-cycle budget.
algorithm.budget: clip(L_next + 0.25, 6, 8) N, applied on the NEXT cycle. Effective filter time counts only accepted update cycles.
algorithm.contact_loss: Reset both original compensation and scheduler state.
algorithm.falling_budget: Scheduled cap limits the target request; stored force still falls at the original slew rate, so it can transiently exceed a newly lowered cap but not the global 8 N norm ceiling.
algorithm.filter: L_next = L + (1-exp(-dt/0.20))*(projected_load-L); update only after force, when active, motion-ready and torque projection unchanged.
algorithm.input: Delayed filtered measured_wrench_world from the same causal sample as the original normal-force controller; rotated into its controller frame.
algorithm.missing_input: Reset load estimate and scheduled budget to minimum; do not clear the original coefficient solely because auxiliary measurement is missing.
algorithm.projection: clip(dot(measured_force_local, unit_target_tangent), 0, 8) N; robot-on-environment convention, no sign negation.

controls_before_candidate_runs: Fixed 6/6 and 8/8 N scheduler must exactly reproduce old force cycles; additionally reproduce public case 23/gain 2 and dynamic yaw 0/combined/gain 1 fixed 6 N physics traces.
expansion: Only after A and B pass: add the remaining 36 public24 gain pairs and 6 no_bias dynamic gain pairs with identical parameters; no default promotion from the pilot.
limitations: Public development data already examined; not an unseen holdout.
Candidate adds a measured tangential-force input as well as a scheduling law; this is not an equal-input single-parameter causal comparison.
No claim of beating fixed 8 N catch-up speed. Stage 2 transient tradeoff remains a separate question.
No BC/PPO training or changed baseline claims from this pilot.
Measured load includes inertia, mass/calibration errors, noise and bias; it is not identified friction.
No passivity or physical hardware safety proof; production defaults and historical FAIL records remain unchanged.
purpose: Test a measured-load scheduled 6-8 N ceiling against the frozen fixed 6 N online controller before expanding the public development grid.

stage_a.reference: Same yaw and gain, original fixed 6 N traces.
